items.title: Food cart - one salmon line with a GHS 2,170 total
items.description: A minimal cart: a single 'Pan-seared salmon' line (qty 1, GHS 400) with a round photo and trash icon, a 'Total Amount GHS 2,170' footer and a green Checkout button. Part of the Skybar GHS food flow.

items.title: Food checkout - promo-code field and Mobile Money, GHS 2,140
items.description: A checkout with a promo-code input beside a dark-green 'Promo Code' button, a bill (Subtotal GHS 2,100, Delivery Fee free, Taxes GHS 40, Promo -GHS 0, Total GHS 2,140), a 'Mobile Money' payment row and a green Place Order. Same Skybar GHS flow.

items.title: Campus Laundry tracking - timeline to 'Ready for Delivery'
items.description: A laundry order tracker: status timeline (Handed Over, In Service, Ready for Delivery 'being prepared and awaiting delivery'), 'Campus Laundry' provider 4.9, Delivery details (SU Building, Est Arrival Tomorrow 7:00 PM) and a muted 'Confirm Service Completion' button. Same order as IMG-0369/0370.

items.title: Laundry order #2026-30759 - wash-and-fold service details
items.description: An order header '#2026-30759' (Booked Aug 25, Returns Aug 26) over Service Details (Wash and fold, Handover Aug 25 9:00 AM, 24-hour Turnaround, Load Medium ₦7,000) and a Timeline starting 'Order Confirmed'. The top of the Campus Laundry order also in IMG-0369/0371.

items.title: Banking home 'Jenny' - $3,482.17 with buy/sell/swap/receive
items.description: 'Good morning, Jenny' wallet home: Total Balance $3,482.17 (+12.4% 24h), four round actions (Buy/Sell/Swap/Receive) and a 'Top Movers' row of crypto tiles (BTC, ETH). The same account as IMG-0397/0399.

items.title: Lisbon trip - crew invite card and packing progress card
items.description: Two travel cards: 'Invite - Bring the crew into Lisbon.' (Can edit/View only, ana@ field, Invite, Copy link/QR/Message/More, Show expenses) and 'Packing - 12 of 18 packed. Two days to go.' (segmented bar, Passports/Chargers/Plug adapter/Sunscreen, Suggest items). Same Lisbon trip as IMG-0467/0468.

items.title: Lisbon trip - €2,900 budget card and settle-up balances
items.description: Two cards: 'Budget €2,900 of €4,800, Day 3 of 6' with Stays/Flights/Food/Activities progress bars, and 'Balances - Two transfers settle the whole trip.' (Mara owes €188, Ana €92, Kofi all square) with a black Settle up button. Same Lisbon trip as IMG-0468/0469.

items.title: On-demand services - 'What needs attention?' with floating nav
items.description: A floating rounded panel with two product thumbnails (generator, tool), a 'What needs attention? Select your location and we'll meet you' row, and a white pill nav (Home active in green, history, chat, profile). A services/rental home fragment.

items.title: Crypto holdings - four asset tiles and a recent-actions list
items.description: A holdings grid (BTC $43,280 +3.10%, ETH $8,600 +1.35%, USDC $106, USDT $260) over 'Recent Actions' (Bought BTC ...240.00) with a black floating pill nav overlapping the list. Same account as IMG-0397/0398.

items.title: Campus marketplace - Sony WH-1000XM4 at K240,000
items.description: A hand-held phone listing 'Sony WH-1000XM4' (K240,000, 'Shared item. Available for pickup or campus delivery', Sold by Campus Tech Store, Delivery & Pickup options, Reviews) on a pale 'KONA' watermark field. A campus resale product page.

items.title: Campus Laundry order - the full phone on a white field
items.description: A single phone showing the Campus Laundry order '#2026-30759' with Service Details (Wash and fold), Timeline and provider footer - the complete view whose crops appear in IMG-0370/0371. Watermark lower right.

items.title: Status chips - six labelled pill states
items.description: Six status pills on a white field: Pending (orange), In Review (blue), In Progress (purple), Not started (grey), Cancelled (red), Approved (green). A compact state legend, not five.

items.title: Dashr onboarding - 'Deliver faster, earn smarter'
items.description: A lime-accented onboarding card: 'Deliver faster, earn smarter with Dashr', copy on route optimization and daily payouts, a lime 'Get on the Road' button and 'Already a Dashr rider? Log in'. A delivery-driver landing.

items.title: Claude workspace switcher - sidebar plus accounts sheet
items.description: A 'Claude' sidebar (Chats/Projects/Code/Artifacts, Pinned 'Garden redesign') behind an 'Accounts' sheet listing dannyhertzfeld@gmail.com (Personal, checked), danny.k.hertz@agency.com and workspaces (Vandelay Industries, Kramerica Industries, Pendant Publishing). An account/workspace picker, not a contacts list.

items.title: Banking home 'Jenny' - balance, movers and recent actions
items.description: 'Good morning, Jenny' with $3,482.17, Buy/Sell/Swap/Receive, Top Movers tiles and a Recent Actions list, partly covered by the black floating pill nav. Same account as IMG-0398/0399.

items.title: Lisbon day plan - four-stop list beside a walking map
items.description: 'Day plan' for Alfama & Baixa (4 stops, 11 km): Miradouro da Graça, Tram 28, Pastéis de Belém, Torre de Belém with times and thumbnails, beside a pinned map with a dotted '41 min walking' route and a black 'Optimize route' button. Same Lisbon trip as IMG-0467/0469.

items.title: Rental app in two directions - 'Chatgpt Design' vs 'Figma Design'
items.description: Two labelled phones of a property app: both show 'Apartment 3B', €1,500 rent, an AI Property Assistant card, Quick Actions and Maintenance - left in white/mint, right in cream/black with an orange assistant. A same-brief, two-tool design comparison.

items.title: Sales overview dashboard in light and dark with orange bars
items.description: 'Sales Overview 701.34k +14.6%' rendered twice - light and dark - each with a month bar chart (Apr highlighted in orange), Your Revenue 5,726,450, Monthly Sales 1,264, Active Users and Conversion Rate tiles, plus a floating action cluster. A theme pair of one sales dashboard, not a wallet.

items.title: Food checkout - standard vs scheduled delivery and order summary
items.description: A checkout with Delivery time (Standard 8:22-8:42 PM vs Schedule Mon 10:30-11:00 AM selected), an Order Summary 'Skybar 25' (sirloin x2, schnitzel x2) and a dark-green Promo Code button. Same Skybar GHS flow as the cart screens.

items.title: Add Card - grouped entry form with VISA hint
items.description: An 'Add Card' form: Card Number with a VISA mark, Exp. Date (MM/YY) and CVV (123) side by side, Billing Address (Country or region) and Nick Name (optional, 'Work card'). Clean grouped inputs with generous spacing.

items.title: Food cart - three Skybar dishes with GHS prices
items.description: A 'Cart' for Skybar 25: Grilled sirloin steak GHS 700 (qty 2), Chicken schnitzel GHS 150 (qty 2), Pan-seared salmon GHS 400 (qty 1), each with photo, stepper and trash icon. The multi-item cart of the Skybar GHS flow.

items.title: Health monitor trio - BP log, insulin medication, AI heart chat
items.description: Three health screens: Blood pressure '118/76 mmHg' with a 7-day line chart, Medication 'Insulin Aspart' (12 units, 2x daily, end 30 Jul 26) with logs, and an AI chat 'how has my heart rate been today?' answered with a bar chart and follow-ups. A monitoring suite.

items.title: memrbl reading app - home and the 'Practice Does' sheet
items.description: Two phones of 'memrbl': the home 'Which book is on your mind?' with search and recommended covers (Steve Jobs, Educated, Subtle Art), and the same dimmed behind a sheet 'Books Don't Change You, Practice Does.' with 'Continue With Apple'. Same pair studied as a before-after in IMG-0287.

items.title: Settings - dark-green 'Plant AI Pro' upsell over a grouped list
items.description: A Settings screen with a 'Pro' badge and a dark-green 'Plant AI PRO' card ('Claim up to 80% off Pro, Limited time offer', Claim Offer, leaf mascot) above a grouped list (Language English, Restore Purchase, Rate us, Email Us, Share App).
